useCase: Detecting GAN upsampling 伪影 invisible to the human eye but present in 频域
mechanism: Computes the 2D Fast 傅里叶 Transform and converts to polar coordinates to create a radial power spectral density profile. GAN-based upsampling operations (transposed convolution, pixel shuffle) create characteristic periodic ring 模式 in the 频域 that appear as peaks in the radial profile.
accuracy: 高 - 85-93% for GAN-generated images with upsampling 伪影
name: 傅里叶环形模式检测
source: Dzanic et al. (2020) - Fourier Spectrum Discrepancies in Deep Network Generated Images, NeurIPS Workshop
parameters: FFT size: image dimensions, Radial bins: 256, Peak 检测: scipy find_peaks, Min peak prominence: 2σ above mean
description: 检测 periodic ring 模式 in 2D 傅里叶 频谱 caused by GAN upsampling operations. These spectral 异常 are invisible to human eyes but computationally detectable.

Frank, J. et al. (2020). Leveraging Frequency Analysis for Deep Fake Image Recognition. ICML.

strengths:
• Very reliable for GAN-based generators
• 检测 伪影 invisible to humans

limitations:
